purpose: One bounded cost supplement covering larger output caps, diversified BFCL, serial proposer proxies, eight-demo input stress and the third model. No task scoring or method selection.
proxy_limitations: Eight demonstrations comprise the four previously recorded unscored training-side Qwen responses, each repeated twice. Not eight independent examples and not accepted MIPRO bootstrap demonstrations.
Demonstrations and proposer inputs are reserved predictor-fit units; no selection or final-test answer is included.
A serial rewrite proxy is not an actual native GEPA/MIPRO proposal. Native adapter accounting must still be verified.
The same frozen requests are measured on all three models. Third-model cost only, not frozen-prompt transfer effectiveness.
The first 400 requests, failure and time remain charged. This supplement is not a second throughput repair or a method revision.
